evidence: Overall softness reduces facial and fabric detail, with slightly washed tones, although both children and their clothing remain readily inspectable.
Visible grain covers the appliance and counter, while blurred lettering and softened control edges reduce useful fine detail.
A large dark foreground obstruction covers much of the package, and strong grain and blur further obscure its remaining printed detail.
Grass stems and distant buildings retain clear detail, with minor sky grain and a few faint dark spots in otherwise clean blue areas.
Faces, hair, suit texture, and white dress embroidery are cleanly resolved with well preserved tones and no meaningful visible artifacts.
Town lights, cloud edges, and foreground foliage are well resolved, with only slight fine grain in the broad dark sky.
Strong blur across the scene smears faces, life jackets, rock textures, and water detail, leaving the subjects identifiable but poorly resolved.
Dark exposure obscures much of the lower masonry and recesses, while general softness reduces brick and leaf detail.
Bright glare and clipped whites erase small lettering on the white label and substantial surrounding fabric detail, although the blue volume text remains clear.
Extreme blur removes facial features and nearly all object detail, leaving only broad silhouettes and indistinct color regions.
Bag folds, pavement texture, building edges, and street details are clearly resolved with balanced tones and no meaningful visible degradation.
The sign lettering is sharp and fully legible, but dark exposure mutes its whites and merges some surrounding foliage into deep shadow.
Severe blur erases every face and all writing on the held sheets, with only body outlines and broad clothing colors remaining distinguishable.
Heavy blur spreads the blade edges and obscures nearly all surface pattern detail, though the blade and display support remain recognizable.
Most printed text remains readable, but grain, softened character edges, and a dark lower-left shadow visibly reduce clarity.
The cyclist, clothing pattern, and bicycle parts retain useful detail, with slight softness around the face, hands, and wheel.
Extreme blur makes all faces and clothing markings unreadable and merges the runners and landscape into broad indistinct shapes.
Deep underexposure hides room and furniture detail, while broad pale glare and visible grain further reduce contrast despite clearer foreground blanket texture.
Soft edges and a very dark low-contrast display make thermometer digits difficult to read, with mild grain across pale surfaces.
Rail edges, wet cobblestone texture, curb surfaces, and distant vehicles retain clear useful detail without meaningful visible artifacts.
Strong blur obscures bracelet bead detail and skin texture, while dense grain across the image further degrades the recognizable wrist and jewelry.
Uniform blur softens faces, race numbers, foliage, and ground texture, although runners and several large bib numbers remain discernible.
